hero.subtitle: ProcureOps combines AI, policy intelligence and real-time data to help you find the best suppliers, manage risks and streamline your procurement workflow.

metrics.deterministic_desc: Critical calculations don't rely on unpredictable LLM outputs.
metrics.auditable_desc: TCO and VAT calculations are deterministic and traceable.
metrics.verified_desc: AI outputs are strictly checked against rules and evidence.

principles.title: Built on the right principles
principles.subtitle: LLMs interpret and orchestrate. Deterministic systems calculate and verify. We combine both to build a trustworthy enterprise engine.
principles.card1_desc: Every recommendation is grounded in citations from policy documents, supplier history, and structured quote data. No hallucinated claims.
principles.card2_desc: TCO, VAT, and discount calculations are performed by strict backend code — not the LLM. Results are exact, auditable, and reliable.
principles.card3_desc: AI prepares and explains. Humans decide. Managers can approve, reject, or request revisions with full contextual awareness.

review.title: Human-in-the-Loop Decision Review
review.override_reason_label: Override Justification (Required if different from AI suggestion)
review.override_placeholder: Explain your operational, technical or commercial justification...
review.header_subtitle: Human-in-the-Loop final sign-off and Purchase Order (PO) creation
review.success_desc_po: Purchase Order (PO) created, notification email queued, and audit log updated.
review.success_desc_general: Review status updated and audit entry recorded.
review.opt_standard_desc: Generates PO for verified and compliant quote.
review.opt_exception_desc: Accepts rule or verification override and generates PO.
review.opt_revision_desc: Requests a revised quote from the supplier.
review.alert_stale_desc: Changes were made to RFQ details or quotes. Current analysis is void and blocked from approval. Please reload and re-run.
review.alert_inconclusive_desc: Firm policy evidence could not be verified for this AI recommendation. For legal and audit compliance, Standard Approval cannot be granted. An authorized manager may proceed only via Exception Approval.
review.alert_failed_desc: AI recommendation failed independent verification audit ({status}). Standard Approval cannot issue purchase orders.
review.alert_violation_desc: This quote violates one or more deterministic policy rules. To override and issue a PO, select Exception Approval and explicitly confirm the violation.
review.exception_box_desc: For legal audit and corporate governance, approving non-compliant or unverified quotes requires manager confirmation of the associated operational and commercial risks.
review.exception_checkbox: I have reviewed the deterministic rule violation, policy absence, and operational/financial risks. I confirm exception approval for this quote (acknowledged_policy_violation).
review.comment_placeholder: Enter approval, rejection or revision justification here...

stale.title: Analysis is Out of Date
